conditions.state_and_reference: existing molecule-specific raw ray/full-H reference; no regeneration or renormalization
conditions.compiler: Qiskit1.3.0; rz/sx/x/cx; optimization_level1; seed17; no topology/layout/routing override
conditions.cost: compiled full Hadamard wrapper RZ, preparation excluded

stage_A_saved_reanalysis.scope: New class-specific finite saved-G minima and Hybrid/RTE exact ratios, separately for exploration and independent confirmation. Preserve old H4 primary nominee separately.
stage_A_saved_reanalysis.existing_saved_N_B_bias_allowance: quote only; no new target, shot rule or normalization computation
stage_A_saved_reanalysis.null_policy: Null never 0/infinity; exclude from computable subset with unresolved-ID/status list; never claim entire registered family resolved.
stage_A_saved_reanalysis.H4_historical_candidate: p027_q8_r4_K4 has historical_baseline n256; keep separate reference. Strict exploration minimum uses 140 actual exploration candidates, confirmation uses 4 actual finalists. Do not relabel or pool historical prices.
stage_A_saved_reanalysis.statistics: quote saved SE; use existing paired stats only for new confirmation prices. No exact simultaneous/population-winner claim.
stage_A_saved_reanalysis.lower_bound_screen: Only an already justified saved bound may support skipping confirmation; an observed minimum, exploration mean, missing value or low frequency is never promoted to a population lower bound. Otherwise sample the frozen nominee or report missing.

stage_B_fresh_confirmation.candidate_domain: registered candidates only; no parameter search or adaptive prefix/q/r/K expansion
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.nomination_rule: For each missing molecule/class/precision cell choose eligible finite-G exploration minimum after execution permission; exact ties lexical candidate ID, all ties recorded. Deduplicate the union and freeze IDs/inputs/batch/SOURCE before sampling.
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.H2: no new sampling; reuse 2 existing confirmation candidates n96
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.H4: only Hybrid nominees for epsilon0.001 and0.0005, at most2 distinct candidates; reuse existing RTE and eligible Hybrid confirmations
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.H6: only RTE nominees for 5 precision cells, at most5 distinct candidates; reuse existing Hybrid confirmations
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.fresh_seed_rule: Reuse original candidate-specific SeedSequence rule: H2/H6 [20261025,molecule_size,L_D,q,r,K,202,index], H4 [20261025,3101,L_D,q,r,K,202,index]. Only previously unconfirmed IDs and unused indices; verify no collision with saved records before dispatch.
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.extension_rule: Extend only if nominal Hybrid/RTE G difference is <=2 combined SE AND nominal t95 halfwidth of new candidate >1% of its G. Stop rather than rerun existing successful cohorts when existing comparator uncertainty dominates; at384 stop unresolved if necessary.
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.design_rationale: 48 matches existing H6/H4 Hybrid confirmation; saved price SE is available per candidate. After permitted reanalysis use saved gap/variance to apply this fixed extension rule. No new sample-size calculation was performed in preparation.
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.paired_rule: same trajectory supplies cosine and sine prices; G variance uses paired weighted prices, not independent-axis SE addition
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.cohort_rule: No exploration/confirmation pooling, no pooling different candidates or molecules. New confirmation is a fresh cohort; fixed nominee view and post-confirmation class-minimum view are distinct.
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.target_and_N_rule: Reuse saved target, B, bias, allowance and N for the same candidate/epsilon. SAFE_INTEGER_LIMIT and numerical ambiguity remain unresolved; no threshold/allowance/domain changes.
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.output_policy: Fresh driver and directory; never call old output-bound entry points or reopen their STOPs. Reuse central_trajectory/sampler/compiler/paired-stat kernels.
stage_B_fresh_confirmation.batch_policy: Before each new sampling batch fix exact IDs, candidate config, saved target/N selectors, code commit/hash, runtime, seeds/index ranges and call counts. This is scientific provenance, not approval proof.

stop_rules: No scientific reanalysis, sampling or compile before user's explicit execution permission for this combined scope.

After permission: stop affected fresh batch on input/SOURCE/runtime mismatch, native failure or incomplete result; preserve evidence and do not mark unverified results PASS. No automatic retry of failed calls.
Do not treat transient shared-resource pressure as failed science; adjust only own dispatch/concurrency without changing other users or shared settings.
Technical repairs within approved scope are allowed with fresh SOURCE/batch and preserved failed evidence; no relaxation of historical one-shot/retry restrictions.
If a scientific condition/algorithm, shot rule or fair comparison must change, stop and return the decision to user.
At sample cap, keep near-tie/unresolved/missing classification; do not broaden parameters or recompute successful old cases.
After results, provenance, native exit/reap checks, commit/publication and local/remote verification: mandatory STOP; no important claim adoption or detailed GPT science review.
excluded: new Arb or law-mean state actions
new shot rule or numerical allowance
global optimum or general size scaling claim
resources: Parallel native workers selected from actual availability/workload; no arbitrary CPU/RAM caps; no shared-environment or other-user modifications.
permission_mechanism: User chat permission only; no approval certificate, packet, grant, identity check or approval ledger.
